title: W10785366A — Software Version Display
description: Hold 2nd diagnostic-entry button 5 seconds to cycle n (WiFi) and p (PMM) versions.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Enter Software Version Display
steps.body: From Service Diagnostic mode, press and hold the 2nd button used for entry for 5 seconds. Display cycles UI, ACU, WiFi (n), and PMM (p) revision codes. POWER exits.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Hold 2nd button 5 seconds for Software Version Display.
